note: Files this project's cleaners were ported from. scripts/check-upstream.mjs compares the live content against these hashes; when one moves, re-port the mirror files listed under `mirrors` and update `sha256` in the same commit.
followUp: `tests/golden/imageMeta.json` holds values generated from `unmark-web`. If that source changed, regenerate the golden values as part of the re-port — otherwise the tests keep asserting the old behaviour and the drift ships anyway.

sources.comment: Deliberately partial mirror: upstream added BMP, GIF and TIFF in guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover#107 and unmark-web ports all three, but only GIF is mirrored here — it is the only one of the three that gets uploaded to WordPress in practice. A green check on this source therefore means 'no change we decided to track', not 'byte-for-byte feature parity'. If BMP or TIFF ever matter here, port stripBmp/stripTiff from unmark-web's js/image_meta.js.
